description: This file defines the 'Scheme' data structure and related functions for handling schemes, including validation, serialization, and role management within the Mattermost project.

classes.name: Scheme
classes.description: Represents a scheme with roles and scope, used for permissions and configurations.

classes.name: SchemePatch
classes.description: Struct for patching a Scheme's name, display name, and description.

classes.name: SchemeIDPatch
classes.description: Struct for patching a Scheme's ID.

classes.name: SchemeConveyor
classes.description: Used for importing/exporting a Scheme and its roles.

classes.name: SchemeRoles
classes.description: Represents roles associated with a scheme, including admin, user, and guest roles.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of scheme fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes scheme fields by setting them to default/fake values.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes the scheme to YAML format.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes YAML data into a Scheme object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the scheme's ID and overall correctness.

methods.name: IsValidForCreate
methods.description: Validates scheme fields for creation, including name, display name, description, scope, and roles.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update scheme's name, display name, and description.
